thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-service error rate spike > 5% (5xx) across eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Paging primary oncall: maria. See /incidents/INC-4521 for details

maria: got the page, i'm on it. starting triage now — ping me if you see anything on dashboard.

kevin: i'm secondary tonight, available to take over if you need break.

maria: thanks. initial check: p95 latency also up for embed endpoints, looks like qps is normal but tail errors. suspect KV cache thrash after the canary rollout earlier.

sarah: @maria FYI we did a tiny canary at 22:40 that bumped model variant to v2-quant on eu. Could be related.

maria: noted. running quick grep on pod logs, tails look like OOM-ish, but memory graphs aren't matching. posting a snippet:
```
kubectl logs -n inference embeddings-srv-7f8b | tail -n 60
ERROR RetainableKV: failed to allocate cache shard size=134217728 err="resource temporarily unavailable"
```

maria: runbook pointer: /runbooks/embeddings/kv-cache-thrash.md — follow section "emergency fallback" (step 3 is fast).

kevin: if it's cache shard allocation, one quick mitigation is to flip to small cache profile for that deployment. I can apply patch if you give go-ahead.

maria: go ahead, please. also create a fallback route to v1-quant for eu while we stabilize.

kevin: applying now. command:
```bash
kubectl patch deployment embeddings-srv -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rw/cache-profile":"small"}}}}}'
```

deploy-bot: Deployment patch applied to embeddings-srv in inference by kevin at 23:58. Rolling restart started.

maria: thanks. creating INC ticket and noting mitigations. ticket INC-4521 created and linked in the incident doc.

sarah: routing fallback to v1-quant for eu done (traffic split 80/20). watching metrics.

incident-bot: NOTE: customer-impact assessment: 12 customers reported degraded embeddings quality; priority customers: acquirerX, searchly. 2 requests/sec error sustained per customer at peak.

maria: sent emails to AE on call for acquirerX and searchly. asked for any active queries to be paused where possible.

tim: quick question — apac is still showing errors, are we applying same changes there?

maria: apac (ap-southeast-1) wasn't part of the canary but is showing similar symptoms — might be unrelated autoscaling bug. kevin, can you scale replicas in apac to mitigate?

kevin: scaling apac replicas from 3 -> 6:
```bash
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-srv -n inference --replicas=6 --context=ap-southeast-1
```

deploy-bot: Scale request accepted in ap-southeast-1 by kevin. New pods provisioned (3 -> 6).

maria: logs now show fewer allocation errors and p95 improving. I want a clean handoff note for the next shift: current state = mitigated (reduced errors, fallback to v1-quant in eu, cache-profile small), follow-ups required: investigate allocator behavior under v2-quant, add autoscaler buffer in apac, and schedule a postmortem.

kevin: filing follow-up tickets:
- INC-4522 investigate allocator OOM behavior
- INC-4523 add autoscaler buffer for ap-southeast-1
- INC-4524 add integration test for cache profile fallback

maria: thanks. I've scheduled a 45m retro for tomorrow 10:00 UTC and invited infra, runtime, and SRE leads — calendar link: https://cal.redwood/meet/pm-retro-4521

sarah: added runbook clarifications inline at /runbooks/embeddings/kv-cache-thrash.md (section: detection thresholds).

maria: handoff summary for next oncall (paste into rotation notes):
- Primary: maria (handled initial triage, applied cache-profile small)
- Secondary: kevin (applied patches and scaled apac)
- State: mitigated, errors down to ~0.4% across regions, p95 latency trending down
- Open action items: INC-4522, INC-4523, INC-4524 (owners assigned)
- Customer comms: AE notified for acquirerX and searchly, follow-up emails queued
- Runbook: see edits + emergency fallback sequence verified working

tim: thanks, i'll take the next shift and monitor first hour. one ask: can we pin a quick dashboard for the next 6h with these widgets? i'll make it now and share link.

maria: appreciated. last thing — if anything regresses, revert traffic split immediately to 100% v1-quant and alert oncall.

maria: handing off, logging out at 00:45.

kevin: noted. glhf. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) INC-4521 — closed by maria at 00:50. Postmortem scheduled: https://pm.redwood/incidents/4521/postmortem

maria: will follow up with retro notes and link to recordings in the postmortem doc.

kevin: leaving a short playbook snippet in rotation notes for next oncalls: check allocation logs, patch cache-profile, scale apac if errors persist.

tim: got it. monitoring handoff accepted.
